verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a way to integrate third-party, partner-built agent apps, such as a partner agent marketplace or catalog, into Cline workflows. MCP servers supply external tools and data sources, not partner agent apps, and that belongs to the separate MCP-client story. ACP runs the other way, with other clients embedding Cline. The bare mention of 'plugins' gives no detail on third-party agent apps, and subagents and skills are first-party mechanisms.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows
